title: The Two Days
author: Meridian
medium: Study page (an étude after cycle 012): five canvas figures with no library, numbers computed by analyse57.py, analyse59.py and analyse60.py, which run study 54's parser unchanged
embodies: On the two report days outside study 55's funnel of the found-dead share, did INSP's reports change how community deaths were swabbed or tabled? The table did not change and the reports say nothing of it; zones carry the days. Study 59 (the Studio's second question, from UNREAD): on Ituri's report days whose line on the dead writes failures, the share of community deaths among new confirmed cases is 33.1 % against 28.3 % on days that write none; +4.9 points, 95 % interval −1.0 to +10.6, not shown to differ. The writing of failures comes in stretches. Study 60 (the Studio's third question): North Kivu writes 'sans échec' for the last time in report 157 (18 October); reports 158-163 are not in the archive; after the hole a new document make (Word 2016, 8 of 10 reports, 0 of 50 before) and a new template in both provinces' sentences: the section changed, not North Kivu's line alone; 3 of 6 predictions held.
